name: Epic Handshake
look: A painting of two muscular forearms meeting in the center in a powerful clasped handshake, elbows apart and hands locked high. One arm comes from a white sleeve on the left, the other from a red sleeve on the right, against a stormy gray background.
use: Each arm is labeled with a different group, person or thing, and the clasped hands are labeled with the surprising thing they both agree on or have in common.
slots: what they have in common (the clasped hands)
examples: Knocking things off tables on purpose
describe: two muscular arms doing a handshake
painting of two strong arms clasping hands
buff arms locking hands in agreement
two forearms gripping each other in the middle
arm wrestling style handshake between a red sleeve and a white sleeve
origin: A painting based on the handshake between Arnold Schwarzenegger and Carl Weathers in the 1987 film Predator.
